title: Parking App
description: Showing the real time data and predictions of parking spaces.

options.label: Show only these municipalities, comma-separated. Accepts the name in any language or the internal id, e.g. "Bolzano - Bozen, Merano" or "Bozen, Meran". Leave empty to show all.
Show only these car parks, comma-separated station codes (e.g. "103,105,112"). This is how you build a fixed dashboard for one operator or district. Leave empty to show all.
Show only these data providers, comma-separated, e.g. "FAMAS, GARDENA, SBB". Leave empty to show all.
Show only parkings with these statuses, comma-separated: live, delayed, static. Leave empty for all.
Never show these car parks, comma-separated station codes (e.g. "103,105"). Applied on top of every other setting, so a car park listed here stays hidden even if "parkings" names it.

Which filters the visitor may change, comma-separated: municipality, parking, origin, status, excluded. Use "none" to hide the filter bar completely and lock the view to whatever the settings above define.
Offer the per-card menu that lets a visitor hide a single car park. Ignored when the "excluded" filter is not among the visible filters, because a hidden car park could then never be restored.
Include parkings that publish no live availability.
How recent a reading must be to count as real time, e.g. 30m, 2h.
Readings older than this are not shown at all, e.g. 6mo, 30d.
How often to poll for new readings, e.g. 60s.
Interface language as an ISO 639-3 code. Leave empty to follow the visitor's browser and let them switch; setting it pins the language and removes the switcher.
Override the initial map centre as "lon,lat". Empty fits the view to the data.
Override the initial zoom level, 1-19 (used together with center).
